verses.1: For the kingdom of heaven is equal to that of a man who is its owner. He pays his workers well in advance for their work at the vineyard.
verses.2: After agreeing with the workers, he sent them to his vineyard on the day after the festival.
verses.3: And after three hours, he saw other people in the market, who were also slow in their movements.
verses.4: And he said to them, “Go also into the vineyard. And if I give you what is justly owed to you.”
verses.5: And they went away. Once again, after eight or nine hours, he continued to do the same thing.
verses.6: And when he went out for the twelfth time, he found other people there. He said to them, “Why are you slow all day long?”
verses.7: They say to him, “No one has paid us any wages.” He says to them, “Then go with me to the vineyard.”
verses.8: After the work was completed, the master of the vineyard said to him according to his authority: “Call the workers and start paying them their wages, starting from those who worked last until those who worked first.”
verses.9: And when they came around the twelfth hour, they received their payment in coins.
verses.10: And when the first ones came, they thought that more will be gained. So they took what was given to them in exchange for money.
verses.11: Taking them, they were given to the landlord.
verses.12: They said, “These are those who created one day. You have truly created for us those who will bear the burden of this day and its hardships.”
verses.13: But the one who answered said to them, “Friends, I do not wrong you. You did not call me on Tuesday, did you?”
verses.14: May it be yours, and may you possess it. I want to give this last one to you, just like you did to yourself.
verses.15: Do you not want me to do what I desire? Or is your eye evil because I am good?
verses.16: Thus, the later ones will be first, and the first ones will be later.
verses.17: And as Jesus continued his journey towards Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples with him privately. On the way, he said to them:
verses.18: We are going back to Jerusalem. The son of man will be handed over to the priests and scribes. They will condemn him to death.
verses.19: And they will deliver him to the nations for being crucified and beaten. On the third day, he will rise from the dead.
verses.20: Then, the mother of Zebedaeus’s sons came to him, along with her sons. They worshipped him and asked him for something.
verses.21: And he said to her, “What do you want?” She replied, “I want these two sons of mine to sit one on your right and one on your left in your kingdom.”
verses.22: Then Jesus replied, “Do you not know what you are asking? Can you really drink from the cup that I am about to drink?” They said to him, “We can.”
verses.23: He says to them: “Pour out my cup for me. But sit on my right side. I will not give it to you; it must be given to those who are worthy of it, by my father.”
verses.24: And when they heard this, the ten men argued among themselves over the two brothers.
verses.25: But Jesus, having called them, said, “Do you know that the rulers of the nations rule over them, and that the great ones exploit them.”
verses.26: It won’t be like that among you. But whoever wants to become your high priest must first become one of you.
verses.27: And whoever wants to be the first among you will have to become a slave.
verses.28: Just as the son of man did not come to serve, but to serve and give his soul as a sacrifice in place of many others.
verses.29: And as they were being driven away from Jerusalem, a large crowd followed them.
verses.30: And behold, there were two blind men sitting by the roadside. When they heard that Jesus was approaching, they cried out, “Lord, have mercy on us, son of David!”
verses.31: But the crowd decided to make them silent. Those who were more violent said, “Lord, have mercy on us, son of David.”
verses.32: And Jesus said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”
verses.33: They say to him, “Lord, so that our eyes may open.”
verses.34: But when Jesus took off their shoes, they immediately looked at Him and followed Him.
